name: Cerebras Inference

freeTier.note: A free tier is offered with daily token ceilings that vary per model and have changed over time. No figures are asserted here; limits are learned from response headers where present and from observed 429s otherwise. Record the values from your console in Settings → Quotas for accurate pre-flight planning.

notes: Very high throughput inference. Model catalogue is read from /models when discovery runs. Seed list intentionally empty: hard-coded model ids rot quickly and a wrong id wastes a request.
